svg.aria-label: An osmosis figure: a red blood cell in a solution, before and after. Inside the cell: 0.9% NaCl; outside: 5% NaCl. The solution is hypertonic to the cell. Net water movement out of the cell. The cell loses water and shrinks (crenates)
